1.title: 概覽
content: 島田家族的忍術大師，![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子，為了和平與正義而迅速戰鬥。她是一位全面且多功能的支援型英雄，能同時提供防禦與進攻方面的協助。
當會戰變得混亂，且每位玩家都必須各自為戰時，霧子總能在混亂中存活並發揮影響力。她的機動性使她能快速重新定位，以逃離危險或協助隊友取得擊殺。通常情況下，她會將自己定位在中線，以確保隨時處於「瞬（Swift Step）」和鎖定治療的範圍內。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩風格
content: * 隨時保持在 ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步（Swift Step）與治療御札（Healing Ofuda）的鎖定範圍內，這樣你就能在不投入過多資源的情況下快速拯救隊友或脫離險境。

* 在治療與苦無（Kunai）施壓之間切換，以快速累積 ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現（Kitsune Rush），同時利用爆頭威脅敵方後排。

* 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴（Protection Suzu）保留給高影響力的負面效果或致命時刻使用，而不是單純為了治療價值而消耗它。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 盡早逼出 ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步或 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴護，接著在這些技能冷卻期間重新發動進攻。
* 從多個角度對她施加壓力，藉此封鎖她安全的傳送目標並限制她的逃生選擇。

* 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現視為敵方隊伍最強大的進攻型絕招。保留防禦性技能以求生存、盡可能撤退，或是使用你們自己的絕招來防止她壓制你們的隊伍。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 自動追蹤治療
* 優良的生存能力
* 強大的絕招
* 投射物速度緩慢
* 對抗坦克較弱
* 主要攻擊難以使用

3.1.1.title: 自動追蹤治療
content: 無論你的技術水平如何，每個人都有失手的時候。霧子完全不必擔心這個問題，因為她擁有寬容的鎖定判定。一旦鎖定目標，![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)治療符將會自動追蹤隊友，甚至能轉彎跟隨。這在面對體型嬌小且移動靈活的隊友時特別好用。

3.1.2.title: 高生存能力
content: 支援型角色通常是敵方隊伍首要鎖定的目標。![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子是生存能力最強的支援型角色之一，因為她擁有許多保命工具。苦無（Kunai）也算在內，因為它對攻擊者構成了相當大的威脅。

3.1.3.title: 扭轉戰局的輔助絕招
content: 大多數輔助的絕招都需要與坦克或輸出英雄的絕招搭配，才能贏得會戰。![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)霧子（Kiriko）的狐狸湧動（Kitsune Rush）能強化整個隊伍，通常光憑這個絕招帶來的優勢就足以贏得團戰。

3.2.1.title: 緩慢的治療投射物與有限的鎖定距離
content: 當隊友距離 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子越遠，她的治療緩慢問題就越明顯。在最大鎖定距離時，治療效果可能會因為抵達得太慢而無法拯救隊友。此外，與許多其他輔助相比，治療符（Healing Ofuda）的鎖定距離非常有限，因此霧子在遠距離治療能力上較為遜色。

3.2.2.title: 對抗屏障型坦克時的弱勢
content: 屏障會阻擋 ![](/data/assets/guide/8fd604ed67d2d5bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkunai.png) 苦無（Kunai）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png) 治癒符（Healing Ofuda）。如果霧子與隊友之間隔著一道屏障，苦無造成的傷害將遠不足以將其摧毀。她必須花費額外的時間不斷變換位置，並設法繞過屏障進行遊玩。

3.2.3.title: 主要攻擊難以使用
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/8fd604ed67d2d5bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkunai.png)苦無（Kunai）緩慢的飛行速度、射擊頻率以及低傷害，限制了霧子的進攻能力。雖然命中頭部能帶來巨大的價值，但即使是對頂尖的瞄準玩家來說，其穩定性也非常低。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：治療御札
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)治療御札的使用訣竅**
* 專注於高機動性隊友
* 當隊伍中有像源氏、閃光或毀滅拳王這類高機動性的英雄時，請務必優先治療他們，因為你的另一位輔助隊友可能難以穩定地為他們提供治療。
* 自動追蹤範圍

* ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步和 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)治療御札的鎖定效果擁有相同的 35 公尺範圍。因此，如果你看到隊友身上出現瞬步的指示標記，就代表他們處於 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)治療御札的自動追蹤範圍內。
* 隨時生效的投射物

* 即使沒有鎖定目標，只要隊友接觸到 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)治療御札，他們依然會吸收並獲得治療。這適用於隊友互相走位擋在前方，或是他們處於鎖定範圍之外的情況。
* 無法穿透屏障
* 別忘了，像溫斯頓的防護罩或席格馬的屏障這類可部署的屏障，會阻擋你的隊友接收治療。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：苦無
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/8fd604ed67d2d5bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkunai.png)苦無的技巧
* 在治療間隙使用苦無

* 霧子可以在每次施放![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)御札治療之間，騰出時間發射一枚苦無，且不會犧牲治療輸出。這能提升她的整體傷害輸出並加快絕招充能速度。
* 瞄準頭部
* 即使可能會漏掉更多苦無，但命中一次爆擊所造成的爆發傷害，遠大於連續命中兩次身體傷害。
* 無限射程
* 霧子非常擅長對敵方後排施加壓力，因為她的傷害不會隨距離衰減。試著對敵方的安娜、艾西、禪亞塔以及其他站在隊伍後方的英雄進行射擊。

4.3.title: [Shift]：瞬步（Swift Step）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步（Swift Step）的技巧
* 隨時掌握隊友位置

* * 如果你不清楚範圍內的隊友位於何處，在遭受攻擊時就無法快速使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步（Swift Step）。請務必確認是否有隊友在範圍內，以及他們的位置。
* 傳送至安全處
* * 99% 的情況下，你會希望傳送到敵人無法攻擊你的位置，這樣你才能更有機會存活到下一次使用瞬步（Swift Step）的時機。

4.4.title: [E]：鈴（Protection Suzu）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴（Protection Suzu）的使用技巧
* 當敵方隊伍施加減益效果或負面狀態時再使用

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的生化手榴彈（Anti-Nade）、![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王的傷口與禁療效果，以及艾西或莫加的燃燒效果，都是值得使用鈴來應對的技能範例。

* 如果垃圾鎮女王發現你僅僅為了治療而使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴，她就會知道自己可以利用絕招「大屠殺（Carnage）」輕鬆殲滅全隊。
* 瞬（Swift Step）與鈴的連招

* ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)當隊友不在你的視野範圍內或位於牆後，且你持有 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴時，你可以傳送至他們身邊，並透過鈴和治療來拯救他們。

* 無法淨化某些技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)衝鋒（Charge）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)裂地重擊（Earthshatter），但若時機掌握得當，短暫的無敵效果可以防止這些技能造成的傷害。

4.5.title: 絕招：狐狸湧現
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現的技巧**
* 記住狐狸湧現的剋星

* 除了像 ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖這類治療型輔助絕招外，也要小心像 ![](/data/assets/guide/4a3281f9d6d86612.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftectonic-shock.png)地殼震動、![](/data/assets/guide/6db02d49ff2c55df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmolten-core.png)熔火核心、![](/data/assets/guide/182487a51a584671.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fself-destruct.png)自爆、![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨、![](/data/assets/guide/16d7e47ad5393cd4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonstrike.png)龍魂擊以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)裂地重擊這類範圍型絕招。這些絕招要麼會擊中你們全隊，要麼會迫使所有人離開 ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現的範圍。
* 單獨使用狐狸湧現還是進行連攜？

* 如果你的隊伍擁有像 ![](/data/assets/guide/5a0bd28ab2154772.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftactical-visor.png)戰術鎖定或 ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)龍一文字這類絕招，請保留你的絕招與隊友進行連攜。這樣做能大幅提升兩項絕招的威力。
* 如果你的隊伍沒有特定的連攜組合，那麼就單獨使用狐狸湧現，因為只要敵方沒有可用的反制絕招，這通常能輕易贏下該場會戰。

4.6.title: （被動技能）：牆上攀爬（Wall Climb）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/7d1c537e6929240e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwall-climb.png)牆上攀爬（Wall Climb）的技巧**
* 在不冒險的情況下取得視野
* 與其使用瞬步（Swift Step）來協助牆後的隊友，霧子（Kiriko）可以攀爬上去進行射擊，或是將鈴（Suzu）丟過牆面，然後立即退回掩體後方。
* 額外的生存工具

* 當與鈴（Suzu）和瞬步（Swift Step）結合並輪替使用時，![](/data/assets/guide/7d1c537e6929240e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwall-climb.png)牆上攀爬（Wall Climb）能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子（Kiriko）變得極難被捕捉。如果你攀爬過牆，大多數敵人將無法追上你。

5.1.1.title: 緊急照護
5.1.1.description: 當治療符（Healing Ofuda）鎖定生命值瀕危的隊友時，投射物速度提升 50%。
content: 「當治療符（Healing Ofuda）鎖定生命值瀕危的隊友時，投射物速度提升 50%。」
* 如果你已經發現隊伍對治療的需求量很大，請選擇此項。
* 當隊友生命值瀕危時，能更快獲得治療往往是決定生死存亡的關鍵。他們距離你越遠，此特殊能力（Perk）帶來的效益就越顯著。

5.1.2.title: 算命師
5.1.2.description: 苦無命中時會向你前方的一名隊友發射 2 張治癒符。
content: 「苦無命中時會向你前方的一名隊友發射 2 張治癒符。」
* 攻擊時可獲得免費治療
* 如果你能採取侵略性打法並頻繁發動攻擊，那麼「算命師（Fortune Teller）」是較佳的特殊能力選擇。

* 裝備「算命師（Fortune Teller）」特殊能力後，在每兩張 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png) 治癒符（Healing Ofuda）之間穿插射擊兩發苦無是相當值得的。雖然主要攻擊會產生些微延遲，但她有機會在造成傷害的同時，透過每次命中額外產生的 2 張治癒符來提升治療潛力。

5.2.1.title: 備戰（Ready Step）
5.2.1.description: 瞬（Swift Step）會使霧子在 3 秒內提升 40% 的攻擊與裝填速度。
content: 「瞬（Swift Step）會使霧子在 3 秒內提升 40% 的攻擊與裝填速度。」
* 選擇備戰（Ready Step）後，你的突襲將變得更加致命。請等待隊友需要協助擊殺目標時再傳送過去。

* 保持理智。獲得攻擊加成並不代表你應該總是激進地傳送。![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬（Swift Step）是你最好的逃生手段，因此如果你傳送到多名敵人面前，你很可能無法活著離開。

5.2.2.title: 狐步（Foxtrot）
5.2.2.description: 鈴（Protection Suzu）賦予盟友 30% 的移動速度加成，持續 4 秒。
content: 「鈴（Protection Suzu）賦予盟友 30% 的移動速度，持續 4 秒。」
* 30% 的移動速度非常強大，特別是對於那些需要貼近敵人才能造成最大傷害的英雄來說。

* 例如，當與 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）搭配時，移動速度加成能讓他追上那些原本僅在攻擊範圍邊緣的脆弱目標。

* 更好的脫戰能力。更快的移動速度能讓你與盟友在防禦性地使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴（Protection Suzu）時，更有效地逃離戰場。

6.title: 地圖
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子的機動性與多功能性使她成為每張地圖上的穩健選擇。但由於她可以攀牆並穿牆傳送，擁有大量建築或房間的地圖能賦予她更高的操作上限。長距離的視野對她的苦無（Kunai）有利，但若隊友離她太遠，則不利於使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)御（Healing Ofuda）。請隨時留意你所處的地圖區域並做出相應調整。只要確保自己始終保持在能鎖定隊友以及瞬（Swift Step）的範圍內即可。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子擁有極佳的自我生存能力、射程與機動性。這些特質意味著她最適合搭配衝鋒與側襲陣容，但她多功能的技能組讓她在任何隊伍陣容中都能發揮價值。

Tanks that want to position and move aggressively are good choices. Especially those without barriers or an absorption to block status effects like anti-![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade. For example, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga benefits greatly from ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko because he has no way to block such abilities, and ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush paired with ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)Cage Fight is a deadly combo.

![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子最適合與中距離及前線輸出型英雄搭配。多虧了她的遠程治療與傷害能力，她希望能隨時面對前方並持續進行輸出，而不需要轉身。狙擊手是她最差的搭配選擇，因為她必須轉身背對主要戰場來保護狙擊手。

她可以作為主要的持續治療來源，或是更專注於功能性輔助。從過往經驗來看，她最好的搭檔是![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐，因為他們兩人都能打得極具侵略性，在不依賴對方的情況下生存，並且與相同的隊伍陣容具有良好的協同效應。

8.title: 如何反制
content: * 盡早逼出 ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)瞬步（Swift Step）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)鈴（Protection Suzu），然後在這些冷卻時間結束前重新發起進攻。
* 從多個角度對她施加壓力，以剝奪她安全的傳送目標並限制她的逃生選擇。

* 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現（Kitsune Rush）視為敵方隊伍最強大的進攻型絕招。保留防禦性技能以求生存，盡可能撤退，或使用你們自己的絕招來防止她壓制你們的隊伍。
